reporting-org.narrative: Netherlands Advisory Board on Impact Investing

description.narrative: Through strategic collaboration with its African sister organisations (National Partners), the NAB strengthens impact investing ecosystems in emerging markets. These activities fall under the Programme 2, the Ecosystem building in Emerging Markets programme, through which we support ecosystem mapping in Ghana, Kenya and Nigeria. In the long term, this work will enable Dutch investors to make informed decisions in African markets and more easily identify high-impact opportunities.

activity-date.narrative: The Ecosystem Building in Emerging Markets programme began in 2024 with the funding of two national partners - Impact Investing Ghana (IIGh) and Impact Investors Foundation Nigeria (IIF Nigeria). Since July 2025, the NAB also supports Impact Investing Kenya (IIK).
